passive.name: Deep, Deep Breaths
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When any ally uses their Ultimate, the wearer restores HP for the ally currently with the lowest HP percentage by an amount equal to **10/11/12/13/14%** of the healed ally's Max HP. When the wearer provides healing for an ally, increases the healed ally's ATK by **2.4/2.8/3.2/3.6/4%**. This effect can stack up to **5** times and lasts for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Morn, Noon, Dusk, and Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Max HP by **18/21/24/27/30%** and Outgoing Healing by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer heals allies, record the amount of Outgoing Healing. When any ally launches an attack, a random attacked enemy takes Additional DMG equal to **36/42/48/54/60%** of the recorded Outgoing Healing value. The type of this Additional DMG is of the same Type as the wearer's. This Additional DMG is not affected by other buffs, and can only occur 1 time per turn.

passive.name: Mutual Healing
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%** and increases Outgoing Healing when they use their Ultimate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Refraction of Sightline
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by **16/20/24/28/32%** and increases Outgoing Healing by an amount that is equal to **33/36/39/42/45%** of Effect RES. Outgoing Healing can be increased this way by up to **15/18/21/24/27%**.

passive.name: Enjoy With Rapture
passive.text: At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates **8/10/12/14/16** Energy for a randomly chosen ally (excluding the wearer) whose current Energy is lower than **50%**.

passive.name: Denizens of Abundance
passive.text: After the wearer uses their Basic ATK, their next action will be Advanced Forward by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

entries.name: Behind the Kindness
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **100%** of Natasha's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Love, Heal, and Choose
entries.text: Restores a single ally for **10.5%** of Natasha's Max HP plus **280**. Restores the ally for another **7.2%** of Natasha's Max HP plus **192** at the beginning of each turn for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Gift of Rebirth
entries.text: Heals all allies for **13.8%** of Natasha's Max HP plus **368**.

entries.name: Innervation
entries.text: When healing allies with HP percentage at **30%** or lower, increases Natasha's Outgoing Healing by **50%**. This effect also works on continuous healing.

entries.name: Hypnosis Research
entries.text:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Physical DMG equal to **80%** of Natasha's ATK to a random enemy, with a **100%** base chance to Weaken all enemies.
While Weakened, enemies deal **30%** less DMG to allies for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: Soothe
entries.text: When using Skill, dispels **1** debuff(s) from one designated ally.

entries.name: Recuperation
entries.text: Increases the duration of Skill's continuous healing effect for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: Pharmacology Expertise
entries.text: After being attacked, if the current HP percentage is 30% or lower, heals self for 1 time to restore HP by an amount equal to 15% of Max HP plus 400. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

entries.name: Clinical Research
entries.text: When Natasha uses her Ultimate, grant continuous healing for 1 turn(s) to allies whose HP percentage is at 30% or lower. And at the beginning of their turn, their HP is restored by an amount equal to 6% of Natasha's Max HP plus 160.

entries.name: The Right Cure
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Miracle Cure
entries.text: After being attacked, regenerates 5 extra Energy.

entries.name: Preventive Treatment
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Doctor's Grace
entries.text: Natasha's Basic ATK additionally deals Physical DMG equal to 40% of her Max HP.
